name: Two Gifts
designNote: Aha: both halves give their coins away, for different gifts. Sol and Lune line up in their side nooks to put Lune's Tarnish to sleep; Sol trades his weight to cross the crack and Lune trades for light, then she walks beside him so her light lays his shadow bridge.
hints: Each of them needs a different gift.
Line up in the nooks to calm Lune's Tarnish. Sol takes weightlessness, Lune takes light, then walk together.
